rationale: Attack-surface hardening Phase 0: FormatRegistry gains DecodeLimits so FLAC/MP3/OGG/AIFF/WAV/CoreAudio readers refuse header claims before allocating; bridge localStorage and style presets move from the temp dir to a per-user, per-bridge store; QuickJS realms get a heap ceiling; drop-event dispatch escapes data; IPC servers default to loopback. Asset loading, image/font decoding, design import, Chromium capture, rendering and packaging authority are untouched; the render-assets-and-backends touch is the storage_assets_api.cpp key-value store only.
